elements.notes:
e Estimated. NA Not available.
1 Calculated ZrO2 content as 65% of gross weight.
9 Data are rounded to the nearest hundred thousand tons to avoid disclosing company proprietary data.
10 For Australia, Joint Ore Reserves Committee-compliant or equivalent reserves were 20 million tons, ZrO2 content.
8 See Appendix C for resource and reserve definitions and information concerning data sources.
